Messages.Author: ec...@interlog.com
Messages.Body:
First, let's all congratulate LSJ one more time. This is the best news since I have
been reading this newsgroup.

Now for the questions:
1) When you play reform body in combat, can it be your turn? (The text says this
reacting vampire plays the card, which seems to indicate it is not usable on your
turn but I wasn't sure.)

2) I'm sure this is an old question, but if you use Dragon Breath Rounds with a Zip
Gun, does the shooter still take the one damage, or does the gun burn before that?

3) If a situation arises where a vampire is untapped with zero blood, and has
already hunted this turn, (like using superior Majesty after hunting with one blood
and being blocked, etc.), are you alowed to hunt? If not are you alowed to take
other actions?

Thanks for the help.

Dallas

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
ec...@interlog.com wrote:
: 1) When you play reform body in combat, can it be your turn? (The text says this

: reacting vampire plays the card, which seems to indicate it is not usable on your
: turn but I wasn't sure.)

It is usable on your own turn, as a combat card (*)

: 2) I'm sure this is an old question, but if you use Dragon Breath Rounds with a Zip

: Gun, does the shooter still take the one damage, or does the gun burn before that?

Since the gun was used, the shooter takes one damage (maximum of 1 per combat).

: 3) If a situation arises where a vampire is untapped with zero blood, and has

: already hunted this turn, (like using superior Majesty after hunting with one blood
: and being blocked, etc.), are you alowed to hunt? If not are you alowed to take
: other actions?

You are not allowed to hunt, under the "no repeat actions" rule.
You are not allowed to do anything else, under the "empty-vampire-must-hunt"
rule.

Therefore, the empty, untapped vampire who is prevented from hunting is
stuck, and can take no action.

--
L. Scott Johnson (vte...@regency.wizards.com)
Official VtES Net.Rep for Wizards of the Coast.
(*) - Subject to review by Rules Team

Messages.Author: JlB1925
Messages.Body:
>2) I'm sure this is an old question, but if you use Dragon Breath Rounds
with a Zip
>Gun, does the shooter still take the one damage, or does the gun burn
before that?

You shoot gun, gun recoils and whacks you in the face, causing one point
of damage, opposing minion gets torched and the zip gun becomes useless
and is discarded. You take the damage.

>3) If a situation arises where a vampire is untapped with zero blood, and
has
>already hunted this turn, (like using superior Majesty after hunting with
one blood
>and being blocked, etc.), are you alowed to hunt? If not are you alowed
to take
>other actions?

If you need to hunt but you can't hunt, you're just standing there
agonizing and can take no actions. You can still block.

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
Celeval (cel...@cc.gatech.edu) wrote:
: Minion A pulls a Zip Gun and moves to range.
: Minion B plays Majesty.

: Does Minion A take the 1 damage, since he 'used' the Zip Gun?

No, because Zip Gun deals its damage during strike
resolution [TOM 960206], and S:CE ends combat before
that time.
